Summary of what I did and what I found:

- There were two label-variant issues in the Category column (rows 36 and 38) where “Furnture” was used instead of “Furniture.” I merged those into the allowed label using normalize_labels. This is now clean.
- There were three Region values with extra spaces (“ North”, “East ”, “West ”). I normalized them to the allowed labels.
- I found one exact duplicate row (row 23) and excluded it, keeping only the first occurrence.
- All numeric columns (Quantity, Price, Revenue) are valid and within the expected ranges. Revenue matches Quantity × Price for every row.
- There are no missing values in the columns the question uses (Category, Price).
- One Region value is still missing (row 47); that row is otherwise valid, so I left it as is.

Answer to your question:
